name: eslint-plugin-biological-ui-arch
description: Lint rules that enforce a biological tier architecture (atoms, molecules, compounds, organelles, cells, tissues) in React UI codebases. Works with oxlint jsPlugins and ESLint flat config.
author: Bayram Ali Basgul

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/discover-atoms.ts --format esm --no-dts --platform node --out-dir dist
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/run.mjs && node test/discover-atoms.test.mjs
